metadata.framework: React Router v7 + Zudoku plugin-based SPA
metadata.notes: No credentials available for Clerk auth; protected routes verified as showing auth-gate UI. /status returns 404 (broken nav link). /settings/api-keys returns 404 (API keys plugin not configured). /documentation/test exists but renders no content. Label API v2/v1 version paths unresolvable (return ERR_ABORTED).

nodes.label: Home — landing page with hero, CTA buttons, footer
actions: Click 'Sign up for a Cosmo Cargo account' link [href=/signup]
nodes.notes: Custom Landingpage component. Banner: inter-galactic shipping announcement 3025.

nodes.label: Global search dialog overlay (pagefind)
actions: Close dialog with Escape or 'Close dialog' button
nodes.notes: Accessible from any page via Search button. Pagefind-based.

nodes.label: Solutions header nav dropdown (3 items)
actions: Click outside / press Escape to close
nodes.notes: Header nav dropdown. Also has Products dropdown with nested groups.

nodes.label: Documentation test page (empty MDX stub)

nodes.notes: PlaygroundDialog modal: POST cosmocargo.dev/shipments. Shows welcome prompt if not auth'd.

nodes.label: Global Shipping guide page
actions: Click 'On this page' TOC (Features, Best Practices, Docs Requirements, Restricted Items, Tips, Support)

Navigate to other cargo-handbook pages in sidebar

nodes.label: Premium Fleet Services documentation page
actions: Click 'On this page' TOC (Fleet Overview, Premium Services, Booking)
nodes.notes: Route not protected; hidden in sidebar nav unless authenticated. Publicly accessible via URL.

nodes.label: Members Only — auth gate (unauthenticated state)
nodes.notes: Shows 'Sign in to continue' screen. Protected by RouteGuard: UNAUTHORIZED reasonCode.

nodes.label: Members Only — MembersOnly component (authenticated)
nodes.notes: Renders <MembersOnly /> custom component. Visible only when isAuthenticated=true.

nodes.label: VIP Lounge — auth gate (unauthenticated state)
nodes.notes: Shows 'Sign in to continue'. Protected: UNAUTHORIZED if not auth'd.

nodes.label: VIP Lounge — forbidden (auth'd but not @zuplo.com email)
nodes.notes: Shows FORBIDDEN state. Email must end with @zuplo.com. Renders RouteGuard FORBIDDEN UI.

nodes.label: VIP Lounge — VipLounge component (zuplo.com user)
nodes.notes: Renders <VipLounge /> component. Only @zuplo.com email addresses allowed.

nodes.label: Sign In — redirects to Clerk hosted sign-in page
nodes.notes: Immediately redirects to tolerant-hornet-46.accounts.dev/sign-in. Clerk hosted UI.

nodes.label: Sign Up — redirects to Clerk hosted sign-up page
nodes.notes: Immediately redirects to tolerant-hornet-46.accounts.dev/sign-up. Clerk hosted UI.

nodes.label: Sign Out — clears session, renders main layout
actions: Navigate to any page via header links
nodes.notes: Clears auth state. Shows standard layout with Login button.

nodes.label: API Catalog listing — all APIs with category filters
nodes.notes: Shows 8 API cards. Category filter buttons filter cards. No sidebar.

nodes.label: Shipment API info page (overview, auth, rate limits)
actions: Click sidebar link to any tag page
Click anchor links (Getting Started, Rate Limits, Idempotency, Versioning)
nodes.notes: OpenAPI info page for shipments.json. Sidebar shows all operation tags.

nodes.label: Shipment Management — tag page with 8 operations
actions: Click 'Test' button on any operation to open inline test panel
Select language (cURL, JS, Python, Java, Go, C#, Kotlin, Object)
Navigate to other tag pages via sidebar
nodes.notes: Contains: filter, create, track, cancel, hold, update-priority, get-service-levels, lost-claim, graphql operations.

nodes.label: Shipment Management with inline API test panel open
actions: Fill in parameter Name/Value text inputs
nodes.notes: Same pattern applies to all API operation tag pages. Test panel is inline, not a dialog.
